result_summary.title: Chat Widget broken
result_summary.description: The Chat Widget in sandbox (US-West) is acting up. Sorting and filtering don't work right, and sometimes we just get a blank screen. It's really annoying and seems to be hitting a lot of us. Please fix.

final_diagnosis.recommended_next_action: Verify the configuration of the Chat Widget and its dependencies to ensure they are correctly set up and compatible with each other.
final_diagnosis.evidence_summary: The Chat Widget is experiencing issues with sorting and filtering, and sometimes displays a blank screen. The evidence suggests a configuration issue, possibly related to the Search UI component. Further investigation is needed to determine the root cause and recommend a solution.
